### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **147** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json acc9c57d0a9e9648d5ac3a6911296206bb56b3a9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's own conclusions were not read.

### ① Derived judgments

- D1 — RIGHT, the flat fallback read is gone in both renderers, read at the head. `getCalendarConfig` (ObjectCalendar.tsx:322-336) is one line of code, `return schema.calendar ? (schema.calendar as ObjectCalendarConfig) : null`; the memo depends on `[schema.calendar]` alone (:655); the only `schema.<flat key>` spelling left in the file is a comment at :1058 quoting `calendar-view`. `getGanttConfig` (ObjectGantt.tsx:633-646) calls `warnOnFlatGanttKeys` and then reads `schema.gantt` or returns `{ config: null, invalidBlock: null }`; the 30-key flat pick and the `dependenciesField || dependencyField` limb are deleted. The complete set of `schema.X` reads in ObjectGantt.tsx at the head is objectName, sort, searchableFields, search, gantt, filter, readOnly, label, viewName, type, skipWeekends, showBaselines, persistLayout, navigation, mobileReadOnly, markers, holidays, data, criticalPath — no `GanttConfig` key and no `dependencyField`; `ganttHandoff-25923.test.ts` pins three of those absences on the source text and the compile-time absence on `ObjectGanttHandoff` for every `KnownGanttConfigKey`.
- D2 — RIGHT, the hand-off types retire as the claim says, and the `search` pair stays package-local. `ObjectCalendarFlatFields` / `ObjectCalendarHandoff` are deleted (ObjectCalendar.tsx, the -20 hunk at :131) and `ObjectCalendarComponentProps['schema']` is the published `ObjectCalendarSchema` (:151), pinned by `assertionSchemaPropIsThePublishedElementSchema` in calendarUnionReads-8651. `ObjectGanttFlatFields` is gone; `ObjectGanttSearchFields` (ObjectGantt.tsx:313-321) carries exactly `search?: string` and `searchableFields?: string[]`, `ObjectGanttHandoff = ObjectGanttSchema & ObjectGanttSearchFields` (:324) types the prop (:349), and the pair is read only on the fetch path (:875-877), which `ListView` writes at runtime (its `case 'gantt'` toolbar arm, read in #26411's review). Neither published `@object-ui/types` face declares the pair (objectql.ts:3839-3845, objectql.zod.ts:2972-2976 at the head, comments only in this diff; the pins `gantt-search-keys-10250.test.ts` are unchanged in substance). The plugin entries export by name only `ObjectGanttProps` / `QuickFilterDef` (plugin-gantt index.tsx:20) and `ObjectCalendarComponentProps` (plugin-calendar index.tsx:23, :32), so the changeset's "neither package's entry exports" the hand-off types is true by name; the pair is reachable as `ObjectGanttProps['schema']`, which the changeset's plugin-gantt bullet says in those words. The registries' `inputs` declare `calendar` / `gantt` blocks only (plugin-calendar index.tsx:450, plugin-gantt index.tsx:184), so no registry input and no `sdui.manifest.json` row advertised the flat read, and none needs regenerating.
- D3 — RIGHT, a flat node is refused with a remedy and renders nowhere silently wrong or empty. Calendar: `calendarConfig` null reaches the `if (!calendarConfig)` arm whose text names `startDateField` and says "It belongs on the view's calendar block" (ObjectCalendar.tsx:1448-1454); pinned by the inverted `REFUSES a binding written FLAT on the node` case (unconfiguredRefusal-7029:106-124, asserts the refusal text, `/calendar block/`, and that neither record draws) beside the surviving draw CONTROL (:127-145). Gantt: `config` null reaches `if (!ganttConfig)` whose text now ends "in the view's gantt block" (ObjectGantt.tsx:2330), and `warnOnFlatGanttKeys` (:578-598) names every present `FLAT_GANTT_CONFIG_KEYS` member via `Reflect.get` whether or not a block is beside it, once per distinct key set; pinned by blockPrecedence `REFUSES a node whose binding is written flat with no gantt block` (refusal text, `gantt block`, no `gantt-view`, exactly one warning naming the three keys) with its moved-into-block CONTROL. Producers: ListView.tsx:4254-4266 spreads `calendar: calendarBlock` and :4411-4496 `gantt: ganttBlock`, no flat calendar/gantt key; plugin-view ObjectView.tsx:2328-2345 and :2438-2456 nest `calendar: {…}` / `gantt: {…}`; app-shell `InterfaceListPage` composes view-level `calendar` / `gantt` (:456-462) and `objectViewListRenderer` only warns on view-level flat keys (:194-205) — both feed ListView, which builds the block; `ViewPreview.tsx` folds `options.KIND` onto the view-level `KIND`, upstream of the block build. The demo host moved to `gantt: {…}` (demo/main.tsx:367-383). The map and timeline arms still flatten by design and are not this card's node types. A rough census of my own over the 5,994 test files under `ui/` outside the PR's 44 paths (a `type: 'object-gantt'|'gantt'|'object-calendar'|'calendar'` key followed within eight lines at the same indentation by a flat `startDateField` / `endDateField` / `titleField`) finds 0 sites, consistent with the dev's after-census (7 calendar / 9 gantt flat sites, all inside PR files as refusal or type-level pins).
- D4 — RIGHT, the census is honest and the no-conversion retirement is justified on it. The census file names its tree (origin/main `4b8f8cdc`), its method (TS AST + JSON + YAML over 19,856 files, 14 JSONC parse failures) and its counts (flat calendar 12, flat gantt 23, all tests but the demo host; shipped metadata 0), and says in its own words "Not reachable, so not zero: hotcrm metadata, production tenant `sys_metadata` rows, cloud" — the PR body and the dev report repeat that line; neither counts the unreachable sources as zero. The retirement needs no ADR-0087 entry because no accepted shape moves: the spec refused the flat keys on `object-calendar` / `object-gantt` before this card, `@object-ui/types` stopped declaring them in #26411, and both producers write the block — what goes is a consumer's tolerance of an off-spec shape, which is what Prime Directive #12 forbids keeping. A tenant `sys_metadata` VIEW row is unaffected (its `calendar` / `gantt` / `options.KIND` is read at the view level and the block is built from it); a tenant PAGE row carrying a flat node, which the spec door already refuses, now reaches the "configuration required" screen naming the block and, in dev, the console warning naming each key (D3) — a refusal with a remedy, not a silent drop, and not a renderer-side accommodation.
- D5 — RIGHT, the renderer tests move to the block honestly, with the same assertions. Fixture moves (same assertions, binding relocated): filterContextTokensSweep-10666, widget-dom-leak-sweep, popoverLocale-10747, invalidationRefetch-10572 (also corrects a pre-existing `dateField` alias to `startDateField` inside the block), quickCreateHandoff-12291, refusalRemedy-8170 (both nodes), filterIsNotAConfigSlot-7711 (memo pin now flips `calendar.startDateField`), objectCalendarConfigMembers-8071, propsContract, contractEnvelope-6839, expandFls-7230, exportFileName.i18n (`extra` / `gantt` split), persistfilters, quickfilter ×3, referenceArms-6837, unconfiguredRefusal-7070 (the draw CONTROL moved; the half-axis refusal keeps a flat node on purpose), viewmode, gantt-declared-keys, object-kanban-calendar-navigation-8652. Inverted pins (the fact flipped, assertion kept at the same strength): unconfiguredRefusal-7029 (draw → refuse, D3), blockPrecedence (`still reads the flat spelling` → `REFUSES` + CONTROL; `does NOT fire on the flatten product` → the same shape now asserts exactly one warning; `says which face won` → `says where the keys belong`), ObjectGantt.test.tsx (`forwards summaryExtent from top-level` → `not.toBe('self')` beside a valid block), dependencyAlias (`DEPRECATED singular is still read` → not read when flat, `deps ''` / `autoSchedule 'false'`; new `singular INSIDE the block is refused` on `gantt-invalid-config` naming the key), calendarUnionReads-8651 (`accepts the flat vocabulary` → `@ts-expect-error`; `every one is still READ` → `not.toContain`; the census CONTROL now asserts `calendar` is read and the twins are not), 8466 (read rows and memo-deps rows inverted; the `allDayField` load-bearing behaviour stays pinned in `allDayFieldIsHonoured-8026`, which this diff does not touch). Removed outright, each with its reason: dependencyAlias `aimed at ONE field, identical result` and `an EMPTY canonical value falls through to the alias` (both pinned the `||` limb that no longer exists; the replacement pins the alias as unread), propertiesBag-10859's `FLAT_CONFIG` `it.each` arm (pinned that flattened config keys made the identical call; now refused, pinned in blockPrecedence), and the file `ganttHandoffFlatFields-25923.test.ts` (replaced by `ganttHandoff-25923.test.ts`, which carries the surviving rows — the search pair's types, no double home, the prop typed with the hand-off — and inverts the rest; the PR body names the rename). No assertion was weakened: every removed pin pinned the retired behaviour itself.
- D6 — RIGHT with one polish, the four spec files. `component.zod.ts`: the two `prescription` strings lose only the clause "the flat spelling is only a stored-document fallback the renderer still reads" and now read "the renderer reads the binding there only: the flat spelling is not read" (6060-6062, 7407-7410); the remedy "Write this as a key of the `calendar` / `gantt` config object instead — …" and the `dependencyField` → `dependenciesField` clause are byte-unchanged; `name`, `keys`, `examples` and the strictObject wiring are untouched (the hunks are prose). Both JSDoc blocks (6044-6051, 7373-7386, 7478-7489) are true against D1-D3. `component.test.ts:3293-3295` says "Not read by getCalendarConfig since objectstack#25923" — true. `kernel/functional-completeness.ts`, unedited: its calendar row (:277-304) is "Measured on objectui `main` at `0cf2d6644` (2026-09-21)" and "last re-read on 2026-10-14", and its sentence "`getCalendarConfig` returns `null` with neither a `calendar` block nor a flat `startDateField`" stays true (a node with neither still gets null); its gantt row (:305-319) is "Measured on the console this repo ships (read points recorded in `view.json`, row `list.gantt`)" and says `getGanttConfig` "takes its flat branch only when BOTH dates are present and otherwise returns `null`" — true of the sha it cites and of the built console this PR does not rebuild; the row's verdict, "NO fallback, and no silence", holds a fortiori. `liveness/view.json`: both notes open "re-read at objectui @b9814b334 (2026-10-14)" and describe that sha. No sentence in either goes false; both will need their next dated re-read to drop the flat clause, which is the ordinary re-measure, not this PR. `liveness/page.json` row `regions` carries no calendar/gantt flat sentence. No generated artifact carries the retired wording: `git grep` on origin/main for "stored-document fallback" and "renderer still reads" outside the PR's paths hits only unrelated keys (`staticData`), released CHANGELOGs, and the standing changeset `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-keys-handoff.md` (③).
- D7 — RIGHT, the three comment polishes from 6437594464 are applied: the two consecutive dated #25923 notes in `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466.test.ts` are one paragraph at the head (:32-43), and its read-census rows are inverted (:415-456); `objectql.ts:317-320` no longer says "BOTH authoring faces" ("in the `gantt: { … }` block, the one spelling it reads since objectstack#25923 retired the flattened top-level fallback"); `objectql.zod.ts:1877-1885` no longer lists "the flat node face itself" among producer-fed surfaces and explains why the flat node face takes the binding clause now.
- D8 — WRONG, the changeset's levels. `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-fallback-retired.md:8-9` grades `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` and `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` `minor` beside `Metadata-protocol: none` (:16). Ruling A (scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs:899-925) and AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist #3 decide the level by the kind alone: `none` → every introduced entry `patch`; a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. The kind `none` is the right declaration — no spec key, accepted value or published authoring face moves (the spec and `@object-ui/types` refused the flat keys before this PR); what narrows is a React props type and a drawing outcome, which is not "what a metadata author can write" — so the two `minor` entries are a `none` beside a `minor`, "the half of the ruling with teeth", and the `Check Changeset` run on this head says exactly that (failure at 02:08:14Z: "metadata-protocol declares `none` while a changeset entry is graded `minor` or above … Under `none` the level is `patch`"). The remedy is `patch` on both plugin packages (spec is already `patch`); the `!` title, the BREAKING banner and the marker stay.
- D9 — RIGHT, the dogfood red is not this diff's doing. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts` boots the showcase server (`bootShowcase`) and exercises `/actions/showcase_task/showcase_mark_done`, the activation ledger rows and the MCP `run_action` tool over HTTP — server, action and metadata-store code, no renderer and no `@object-ui/*` package. This diff touches `ui/` renderers and tests, two spec prose constants and one spec test comment, none of which the booted showcase reads. Five sibling dogfood files flip `showcase_mark_done` or write `showcase_task` `done` (`action-activation-door-live`, `activation-ledger-actor`, `showcase-record-write-actions`, `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces`, `object-hook-lifecycle-showcase`), which is the shape of the two failures the dev reports (acceptance[0] read `done` true before the disabled action ran; acceptance[5]/[2] found a row id where none was expected) and consistent with the file passing alone on the same head (8/8). So: battery ordering, pre-existing, not a consequence of this change — and a defect in its own right (③).
- D10 — RIGHT, CI measures the one NOT-MEASURED derived gate. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is a step of `Build Core` in ci.yml (:2945, "Every published require entry point actually loads"), which runs on this head because a `packages/spec` path is in the diff; its conclusion is in the ③ readings.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-fallback-retired.md` (root `.changeset/`, right for `ui/**` packages): `@object-ui/plugin-calendar: minor`, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt: minor`, `@objectstack/spec: patch`; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` whose facts hold (no spec key, accepted value, stored row or stored shape moves; the census; the narrowed members are package-local types; the packages publish; no ADR-0087 id covers it); a BREAKING banner with Before / Now / Fix, the fix naming the block and the `titleField` requirement the flat branch used to floor. The PR body carries the same two declaration lines plus `Skills-docs: none` with two citations.
- Level: `patch` on all three is the honest grade under ruling A, and the two `minor` entries are refused by the gate (D8). `@objectstack/spec` at `patch` is right (prose only). `@object-ui/types` carries comment and test changes only (objectql.ts and objectql.zod.ts hunks are JSDoc; the six test files are tests) and takes no entry — the gate did not object, and the changeset's level gate is the one reader. No `fixed`-group lift follows from `patch`.
- Kind: `none` is right. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: right — nothing widens, and a published public surface narrows (`ObjectCalendarComponentProps['schema']` and `ObjectGanttProps['schema']` lose the flat keys as compile errors; a host's flat node stops drawing), so the `(narrowing)` arm, which the ADR-0087 gate and the queue guard read, is owed and declared on both carriers. `Skills-docs: none`: right — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:289-304` and `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md:289-305` teach the `gantt` block only and the latter already says a flat `startDateField` on the node is refused by name; `git grep object-(gantt|calendar)` under `skills/` hits only those two spans.

### ③ Boundary flags

- FAIL reason D8 — changeset level: `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-fallback-retired.md:8-9` `minor` ×2 under `Metadata-protocol: none`; fix is `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` and `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`, nothing else in the file moves. `Check Changeset` on the head is red on this and only this.
- Dev acceptance note "functional-completeness.ts and liveness/view.json not edited, no sentence goes false": VERIFIED sentence by sentence (D6). ESCALATED to the seat as a note, not a defect: both carry present-tense descriptions of the flat branch anchored to a sha; the next dated re-read of rows `list.calendar` / `list.gantt` should drop the flat clause.
- Dev acceptance note "the only other copy is `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-keys-handoff.md`, left as written": VERIFIED (the grep in D6). ESCALATED to the seat: that standing, unreleased changeset says "The renderer is unchanged: the `calendar` block wins, and the flat spelling is read only without it" and will compile into the same release's CHANGELOG as this one; each describes its own PR truthfully and the later entry states the newer state, so no edit is owed by this PR, but the seat may prefer a one-clause amendment there ("retired in a later slice") so an upgrading reader who greps `ObjectGanttFlatFields` is not told the read survives.
- Dev acceptance note "`@object-ui/types` comment and test changes only, no bump": VERIFIED (D5, ②).
- Dev acceptance note "Unreachable for the census: hotcrm, tenant `sys_metadata` rows, cloud": VERIFIED as honestly stated in the census file, the PR body and the report (D4).
- Dev deviation "`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT-MEASURED, exit 3": ANSWERED — it is a `Build Core` step and CI measures it on this head (D10).
- Dev flag "dogfood battery red in `packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live`, green alone; observation only, not filed": the attribution is ANSWERED (D9, not this diff's doing). ESCALATED to the seat: an order-dependent red inside the full battery is a reproducible defect under Prime Directive #10 and the main-red convention, and the dev's "carrier: none" leaves it unfiled; the seat should file it or name the card that carries it. `Dogfood Regression Gate` on this head is success with its three shards path-skipped, so CI did not run the battery for this PR; the dogfood owed by the narrowing arm is the dev's local run, honestly reported.
